_comment: Disclosure needles enforced by scripts/note_audit.py on every delivered note (Step 9 / Verification and delivery gates in SKILL.md). 'required' strings must appear in visible text; 'required_if' strings become mandatory only when a trigger substring appears. Round 3: entries may be scoped with 'near' + 'within' — the disclosure must sit within N normalized characters of a near token, so a label parked in the footer cannot inertly satisfy a content-adjacent disclosure. Pick near tokens that do NOT appear inside the 'then' string itself, or the scoping is vacuous. Matching is dash/case/whitespace-tolerant. Round 4 (reports 8/9 C-1/M-3): 'not a research report' (the internal-use legend — the deliverable is an IC pre-read, never client research) and 'Public-source-only' (the hard limitation statement — no channel checks, expert calls, surveys, or management access) are required on every note. Keep in sync with the skill's own rules; extend per engagement (engagement-specific headline figures belong in a per-run checks file passed via --checks, not here).
